title: Gateway slot APIs allow invalid dimensions and ordinals to panic or exhaust CPU
description: P2 security review finding. The newly exported rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs exposes unchecked coordination/config dimensions. SuperframeConfig has public duration_s and slots_per_superframe fields; superframe_id()/current_slot() divide or modulo by them and panic when either is zero. The free timestamp helpers have the same divide/modulo-by-zero behavior. SlotAllocator::allocate_for_ordinal() documents ordinal < gateway_count but never enforces it; contiguous allocation loops 0..ordinal and performs unchecked u32 additions/range endpoints, so an untrusted very large ordinal can cause CPU exhaustion or overflow/panic. validate_interleaved_pattern likewise performs unchecked u32 multiplication/addition. Replace panicking constructors/raw public fields with validated fallible construction or explicit Result errors, reject zero dimensions and ordinal >= gateway_count, use checked arithmetic, and add hostile boundary tests.
